{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# This workflow is provided via the organization template repository
#
# https://github.com/nextcloud/.github
# https://docs.github.com/en/actions/learn-github-actions/sharing-workflows-with-your-organization
#
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2023-2024 Nextcloud GmbH and Nextcloud contributors
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

name: Npm audit fix and compile

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    # At 22:30 on Saturdays
    - cron: '30 22 * * 6'

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60

    env:
      # env variable for maintainers: 'false' disables auto-merge for these pull requests
      AUTOMERGE: true

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        branches:
          - ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
          - 'stable35'
          - 'stable34'
          - 'stable33'

    name: npm-audit-fix-${{ matrix.branches }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        id: checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ matrix.branches }}
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Check for active merge freeze
        id: freeze
        if: steps.checkout.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          BRANCH_NAME: ${{ matrix.branches }}
        run: |
          if [[ ! -f .github/workflows/block-merge-freeze.yml ]]; then
            echo 'No block-merge-freeze workflow, continuing'
            exit 0
          fi
          if [[ "$BRANCH_NAME" == 'main' || "$BRANCH_NAME" == 'master' ]]; then
            SERVER_REF='master'
          elif [[ "$BRANCH_NAME" =~ ^stable[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            SERVER_REF="$BRANCH_NAME"
          else
            echo 'Not based on master/main/stable*, so skipping freeze check'
            exit 0
          fi
          curl -sf "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nextcloud/server/$SERVER_REF/version.php" --output version.php
          if grep 'OC_VersionString' version.php | grep -q -i -E '(\.0\.0 RC[3-9]|\.[1-9][0-9]* RC)'; then
            echo "Merge freeze is active for $SERVER_REF, skipping"
            echo 'active=true' >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi
          rm version.php

      - name: Read package.json node and npm engines version
        if: steps.freeze.outputs.active != 'true'
        uses: nextcloud-libraries/parse-package-engines-action@39fcc545a815c353dd0a3fd8fd2ef6e59fd02b92 # v0.2.0
        id: versions

      - name: Set up node ${{ steps.versions.outputs.node-version }}
        if: steps.freeze.outputs.active != 'true'
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.node-version }}

      - name: Set up npm ${{ steps.versions.outputs.package-manager-version }}
        if: steps.freeze.outputs.active != 'true'
        run: npm i -g 'npm@${{ steps.versions.outputs.package-manager-version }}'

      - name: Fix npm audit
        id: npm-audit
        if: steps.freeze.outputs.active != 'true'
        uses: nextcloud-libraries/npm-audit-action@1b1728b2b4a7a78d69de65608efcf4db0e3e42d0 # v0.2.0

      - name: Run npm ci and npm run build
        if: steps.freeze.outputs.active != 'true' && steps.checkout.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          CYPRESS_INSTALL_BINARY: 0
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run build --if-present

      - name: Create Pull Request
        id: create-pull-request
        if: steps.freeze.outputs.active != 'true' && steps.checkout.outcome == 'success'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@5f6978faf089d4d20b00c7766989d076bb2fc7f1 # v8.1.1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.COMMAND_BOT_PAT }}
          commit-message: 'fix(deps): Fix npm audit'
          committer: GitHub <noreply@github.com>
          author: nextcloud-command <nextcloud-command@users.noreply.github.com>
          signoff: true
          branch: automated/noid/${{ matrix.branches }}-fix-npm-audit
          title: '[${{ matrix.branches }}] Fix npm audit'
          body: ${{ steps.npm-audit.outputs.markdown }}
          labels: |
            dependencies
            3. to review

      # Approve using the default GITHUB_TOKEN, as the PR itself was created
      # using COMMAND_BOT_PAT and GitHub does not allow an account to approve its own PR
      - name: GitHub actions bot approve
        if: steps.freeze.outputs.active != 'true' && steps.create-pull-request.outputs.pull-request-operation != 'none'
        run: gh pr review --approve "$PR_URL"
        env:
          PR_URL: ${{ steps.create-pull-request.outputs.pull-request-url }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Enable auto merge
        if: steps.freeze.outputs.active != 'true' && steps.create-pull-request.outputs.pull-request-operation != 'none' && fromJSON(env.AUTOMERGE)
        uses: peter-evans/enable-pull-request-automerge@a660677d5469627102a1c1e11409dd063606628d # v3.0.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          pull-request-number: ${{ steps.create-pull-request.outputs.pull-request-number }}",
  "rationale": "The workflow lacks a job timeout, which can lead to runaway resource consumption. Evidence from a measured experiment (experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508) shows adding a 5-minute timeout reduced elapsed time by 26.8% on a similar Node.js workflow. Literature pattern P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT reports 12.9% free VM time reduction. Based on this workflow's history (successful runs up to 54 minutes), a 60-minute timeout provides operational headroom while bounding runaway jobs.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}
